About us

The 5th Kajang Company

The Boys' Brigade (BB) gives young people the chance to enjoy a wide range of fun, wholesome, character-building activities based on Christian principles. In Malaysia, the BB is registered as The Boys' Brigade in Malaysia (BBM) and is recognised by the Ministry of Youth and Sports.

Each local chapter is called a "Company". We are the 5th Kajang Company, the fifth company established in Kajang, founded in 2020 by Captain Leonard Wan Yi Hang under the sponsorship of Kajang Chinese Methodist Church.

Every Company keeps a close partnership with a church, which guides its Christian education.

Registered with BBMEst. 2020Kajang, Selangor
What we do

Fun with a purpose, every Saturday

Members learn discipline, teamwork and leadership through activities that are good fun in their own right.

Three sections, one journey

Members join the section for their age and move up as they grow, from their first Saturday to helping lead the company.

Join us

You're always invited

There's no better time to join than now. We welcome new members at any time of the year, and we hold our recruitment drive at the start of every year. Bring your children, their classmates and friends to one of our Saturday meetings.
